services.title: Name Change / Change of Ownership with EPID (GBA Area)
services.description: Fast-track instant ownership transfer for Greater Bengaluru Area (GBA) premises having a valid e-Katha Property Identification (EPID) number. Input Account ID & EPID to auto-verify owner info and eSign digitally.

steps.title: Enter Account ID & EPID
steps.details: Log into bescom.co.in, select 'Name Change with EPID', and enter your 10-digit BESCOM Account ID and BBMP EPID number.

steps.title: Auto-Fetch & Verify Owner Info
steps.details: System automatically cross-verifies EPID property owner record with BBMP database.

steps.title: Pay Fee & Perform Aadhaar eSign
steps.details: Pay ₹100 name change fee online and eSign Power Supply Agreement & Indemnity Bond.

steps.title: 24-Hour Approval & Bill Update
steps.details: Application is approved within 24 hours. Updated owner name will reflect on the next bill.

documents.name: BBMP EPID (e-Katha Property Identification) Number
documents.note: Used for instant GBA owner auto-verification

documents.name: 10-digit BESCOM Account ID
documents.note: Found on monthly electricity bill

documents.name: Aadhaar Card (linked with active mobile)
documents.note: Required for OTP eSign

services.title: Name Change / Change of Ownership without EPID (Offline SDO Submission)
services.description: For non-EPID properties or premises outside GBA limits, applicants must visit their concerned local BESCOM Sub-Division Office (SDO) in person to submit physical copies of ownership documents, indemnity bond, and identity proof.

steps.title: Visit Local BESCOM Sub-Division Office (SDO)
steps.details: Obtain physical application form for 'Transfer of Installation (Name Change)' from your local SDO counter.

steps.title: Attach Physical Property & Indemnity Documents
steps.details: Attach photo copies of registered Sale Deed, Khata Certificate, latest paid electricity bill, and Annexure-9 Indemnity Bond on stamp paper.

steps.title: Physical Verification by Sub-Divisional Officer / AE
steps.details: Present original documents for physical verification by Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) at SDO.

steps.title: Pay Counter Fee & Collect Acknowledgement
steps.details: Pay ₹100 name change processing fee at cash counter and collect official acknowledgement receipt.

steps.title: Billing Record Transfer
steps.details: Name change is processed and updated name reflects on your bill in the subsequent billing cycle.

documents.name: Registered Sale Deed / Khata Certificate / Tax Receipt
documents.note: Physical copy + original for SDO verification

documents.name: Latest Paid BESCOM Bill
documents.note: Zero pending dues required

documents.name: Annexure-9 Indemnity Bond on Stamp Paper
documents.note: Format for Transfer of Installation as per KERC CoS

documents.name: Applicant ID & Address Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
documents.note: Photo copy self-attested

fees.amount: As per KERC stamp duty rates

services.title: New Connection & Tapping Connection (<= 17.5 kW)
services.description: Fast-track power supply (New Connection & Tapping Connection) within 24 hours after payment of requisite fees to Domestic (LT-1) and Commercial (LT-3) consumers where total load is <= 17.5 kW (18 kW max) and no electrical line extension is needed.
eligibility: No line extension or electrical network modification required
exclusions: Premises requiring line extension or electrical network modification
Buildings exceeding 15 meters height or total plinth area > 500 sq.mt
Buildings attracting Clause 9 Conditions of Power Supply
Connections in unauthorised, revenue, or abandoned layouts
Incomplete internal wiring, meter board, or service main cable
complianceRules: Surrender temporary connection if previously availed
Pay pending arrears & additional demand charges ascertained during spot inspection
Payment of all applicable Deposits/charges as per Clause 4.03 of KERC Power Supply Regulations
Power supply Agreement execution as per Clause 32 of Conditions of Supply (CoS)
Contractor's Completion-cum-Test Report along with wiring diagram (Clause 4.03(ii)(d) of CoS)
Mandatory Undertaking for installing Solar Water Heating System for new residential buildings with built-up area of 600 sq.ft & above on sites measuring 1200 sq.ft & above
services.refundPolicy: If application is rejected due to non-compliance, registration fee & GST are forfeited, but MSD, AISD, SLC, and ASLC deposits will be refunded. If applicant voluntarily withdraws before agreement execution, 10% of total amount is deducted per KERC Clause 4.03 Note and balance is refunded.

steps.title: Register Application Online or Offline at SDO
steps.details: Submit Janasnehi Fast Track application online via BESCOM / Seva Sindhu portal or offline at Sub-Division Office.

steps.title: Spot Inspection & Document Verification
steps.details: Field officer conducts spot inspection. Submit photo copies along with original documents prescribed under Clause 4.02(ii) KERC for verification.

steps.title: Submit Contractor Test Report & Solar Undertaking
steps.details: Submit Licensed Electrical Contractor Test Report & wiring diagram (Clause 4.03(ii)(d)) and mandatory Solar Water Heating undertaking (for sites ≥ 1200 sq.ft).

steps.title: Execute Agreement & Pay Requisite Fees
steps.details: Pay MSD, AISD, SLC, ASLC charges online or at SDO counter.

steps.title: 24-Hour Connection & Meter Energization
steps.details: Power supply connection & meter energization completed within 24 hours of fee payment.

documents.name: Property Ownership Proof / Sale Deed / BBMP Khata
documents.note: Clause 4.02(ii) KERC Regulations (Original for spot verification)

documents.name: Contractor's Completion-cum-Test Report & Wiring Diagram
documents.note: Clause 4.03(ii)(d) of CoS issued by Licensed Electrical Contractor

documents.name: Applicant ID & Address Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID)
documents.note: Verified by concerned SDO

documents.note: Mandatory for residential sites ≥ 1200 sq.ft with built-up area ≥ 600 sq.ft

documents.name: Surrender Certificate of Temporary Connection
documents.note: Mandatory if temporary connection was previously availed

fees.amount: As per KERC Clause 4.03 demand note (100% Refundable if rejected)

services.title: Tariff Change (Monthly Tariff Schedule Reclassification)
services.description: Reclassify your electricity tariff schedule (e.g. from Monthly LT1 Domestic to LT3 Commercial or vice versa) by providing your 10-digit BESCOM Account ID, specifying the nature of new activity & reason, and attaching identity & property proof.

steps.title: Enter Account ID & Auto-Fetch Existing Tariff
steps.details: Enter your 10-digit Account ID (e.g. 1089688558). System auto-populates your current tariff schedule (e.g. Monthly LT1 domestic).

steps.title: Select Requested Tariff & Activity Details
steps.details: Select requested target tariff, enter Nature of New Activity (e.g., Shop, Office, EV Charging), and specify Reason for change.

steps.title: Upload Mandatory Documents (Max 4MB / DigiLocker)
steps.details: Upload Identity Proof (Aadhaar via DigiLocker / PAN / Driving License / Passport / Voter ID) and Property Documents (Sale Deed / Khata / Tax Receipt).

steps.title: Upload Supporting Clearances & Annexure-9 Indemnity
steps.details: Attach local authority trade license / clearance (if applicable), Annexure-9 Indemnity Bond, and undertaking for prior dues.

steps.title: 24-Hour Approval & Billing Reclassification
steps.details: BESCOM verifies documents and updates tariff schedule in billing server within 24 hours.

documents.name: Identity Proof (Mandatory *)
documents.note: Aadhaar (DigiLocker direct integration) / PAN Card / Driving License / Passport / Voter ID

documents.name: Property Documents (Mandatory *)
documents.note: Photo copy of Sale Deed, Khata Certificate, or Tax Paid Certificate

documents.name: Local Authority License / Clearance
documents.note: BBMP / Local body clearance if required under statute for new commercial activity

documents.name: Annexure-9 Indemnity Bond Format
documents.note: As per Transfer of Installation format in KERC Conditions of Supply

documents.name: Undertaking for Prior Outstanding Dues
documents.note: Undertaking to pay any short claims or prior dues detected at later stage

fees.amount: Differential ISD if upgrading to commercial tariff
Max total size: 4MB (PDF / JPEG / PNG / GIF / BMP / TIFF; unencrypted for eSign)

services.title: Load Enhancement (<= 17.5 kW)
services.description: Increase your sanctioned electricity load (up to 17.5 kW) within 24 hours to accommodate new Air Conditioners, EV Chargers, or commercial equipment.

steps.title: Submit Load Enhancement Application
steps.details: Apply online with Account ID and additional requested load in kW.

steps.title: Pay Additional Security Deposit (ISD)
steps.details: Pay ₹1,200/kW (Domestic) or ₹2,000/kW (Commercial) for additional load online.

steps.title: 24-Hour Load Sanction Update
steps.details: Sanctioned load updated on BESCOM central server within 24 hours.

documents.name: Latest Paid BESCOM Bill
documents.note: No arrears pending

documents.name: Contractor Test Report (for load > 5 kW)
documents.note: Required for total load above 5 kW

services.title: Load Reduction (<= 17.5 kW)
services.description: Reduce your sanctioned load to lower monthly fixed demand charges when load requirements decrease.

steps.title: Apply for Load Reduction
steps.details: Submit reduction request with revised kW capacity on BESCOM portal.

steps.title: 24-Hour Approval & Fixed Charge Adjustment
steps.details: Sanctioned load is reduced within 24 hours, reducing your monthly fixed charge on future bills.

documents.name: Latest Electricity Bill
documents.note: Account must have zero pending dues

documents.name: Self Declaration / Reason for Reduction
documents.note: Specify reduced load requirement

services.title: Normal To Smart Meter Conversion
services.description: Upgrade your existing electromechanical or electronic meter to a digital Smart Meter with real-time remote reading, outage alerts, and prepaid functionality.

steps.title: Submit Smart Meter Upgrade Request
steps.details: Apply online or via BESCOM Mithra App specifying your Account ID.

steps.title: Technician Visit & Replacement
steps.details: BESCOM meter technician replaces legacy meter with smart meter.

steps.title: Smart Meter Activation
steps.details: Smart meter starts transmitting live consumption metrics to BESCOM Mithra App.

documents.name: Latest BESCOM Bill
documents.note: Account verification

steps.title: Bill Settlement & Deposit Transfer
